data.title: 信浓 · 浴后榻榻米的敏感梳毛
data.description: 沐浴后身上带着玫瑰体温与氤氲水汽，信浓跪趴在榻榻米上。当敏感的狐耳根部与九尾被你温柔梳理时，她忍不住娇躯轻颤、双颊通红，溢出甜美细碎的喘息。
data.location: warm tatami chamber with steam drifting from nearby bath
data.action: flushed from warm bath, damp silver hair, trembling delightfully as sensitive fox ears and tail bases are tenderly brushed, breathless moans, blushing red
data.lighting: warm amber lantern glow accentuating steamy glistening skin
data.mood: intensely sensual, sensitive vulnerability, sweet whimpers
data.promptProse: Flushed from a hot bath on tatami, Shinano shivers with delight as her sensitive fox ears and fluffy tails are lovingly brushed, moaning softly.
data.animaCaption: Shinano shivering with sweet sensitivity during tail grooming after a bath.
